items.informal_name: Product Inequality for Submultiplicative Functions on Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : CommMonoid M] (f : M → R),
  (∀ (a : M), 0 ≤ f a) →
    f 1 ≤ 1 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $M$ be a commutative monoid and $f : M \to R$ a function satisfying three conditions: (1) non-negativity ($f(a) \geq 0$ for all $a \in M$), (2) unit bound ($f(1) \leq 1$), and (3) submultiplicativity ($f(xy) \leq f(x)f(y)$ for all $x,y \in M$). For any finite set $s$ and function $g : s \to M$, the inequality $f\left(\prod_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \prod_{i \in s} f(g(i))$ holds.

items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Function Inequality on Predicate-Closed Sets in Commutative Monoids
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : CommMonoid M] (f : M → R) (p : M → Prop),
  (∀ (a : M), 0 ≤ f a) →
    f 1 ≤ 1 →
      (∀ (a b : M), p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) →
        (∀ (a b : M), p a → p b → p (a * b)) →
          ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), (∀ a ∈ s, p (g a)) → f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $ M $ be a commutative monoid and $ f : M \to R $ a function satisfying: (1) $ f(a) \geq 0 $ for all $ a \in M $; (2) $ f(1) \leq 1 $; (3) $ f(ab) \leq f(a)f(b) $ for all $ a,b \in M $ satisfying predicate $ p $; and (4) $ p $ is closed under multiplication. For any finite set $ s $ and elements $ g_i \in M $ with $ p(g_i) $ for all $ i \in s $, it holds that $ f\left(\prod_{i \in s} g_i\right) \leq \prod_{i \in s} f(g_i) $.

items.type:

  [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  f 1 ≤ 1 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $M$ be a monoid and $N$ an ordered commutative monoid. For any submultiplicative function $f : M \to N$ satisfying $f(1) \leq 1$ and $f(xy) \leq f(x)f(y)$ for all $x,y \in M$, and for any finite set $s$ with elements $g_i : \iota \to M$, the inequality $f\left(\prod_{i \in s} g_i\right) \leq \prod_{i \in s} f(g_i)$ holds.

items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Function Inequality on Finite Products with Predicate Closure
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid M] [inst_1 : CommMonoid N] [inst_2 : PartialOrder N]
  [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop),
  f 1 ≤ 1 →
    (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) →
      (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x * y)) →
        ∀ (g : ι → M) {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) → f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $M$ and $N$ be an ordered commutative monoid. For a function $f : M → N$ satisfying $f(1) ≤ 1$ and $f(xy) ≤ f(x)f(y)$ for all $x, y$ in a predicate-closed subset $p ⊆ M$ (i.e., $p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ p(xy)$), and for any finite set $s$ of elements $g_i ∈ M$ with $p(g_i)$ for all $i ∈ s$, it holds that $f(\prod_{i ∈ s} g_i) ≤ \prod_{i ∈ s} f(g_i)$.

items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Function Inequality for Multiset Products
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CommMonoid α] [inst_1 : CommMonoidWithZero β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [PosMulMono β] (f : α → β),
  (∀ (a : α), 0 ≤ f a) →
    f 1 ≤ 1 → (∀ (a b : α), f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) → ∀ (s : Multiset α), f s.prod ≤ (Multiset.map f s).prod
items.informal_description: Let $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ be a function satisfying three properties: (1) non-negativity ($ 0 \leq f(a) $ for all $ a $), (2) normalization condition ($ f(1) \leq 1 $), and (3) submultiplicativity ($ f(a \cdot b) \leq f(a) \cdot f(b) $ for all $ a, b $). For any multiset $ s $ over $ \alpha $, the inequality $ f(\prod s) \leq \prod_{x \in s} f(x) $ holds, where $ \prod s $ denotes the product of elements in the multiset $ s $.

items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Function Inequality for List Products
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_5} {β : Type u_6} [inst : Monoid α] [inst_1 : CommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedMonoid β]
  (f : α → β), f 1 ≤ 1 → (∀ (a b : α), f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) → ∀ (l : List α), f l.prod ≤ (List.map f l).prod
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be ordered commutative monoids. If $f : \alpha \to \beta$ satisfies $f(1) \leq 1$ and $f(a \cdot b) \leq f(a) \cdot f(b)$ for all $a, b \in \alpha$, then for any list $l = [a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n] \in \text{List } \alpha$, it holds that $f(a_1 \cdot a_2 \cdot \dots \cdot a_n) \leq f(a_1) \cdot f(a_2) \cdot \dots \cdot f(a_n)$.

items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Product Inequality in Ordered Monoids
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid M] [inst_1 : CommMonoid N] [inst_2 : PartialOrder N]
  [IsOrderedMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  (∀ (x y : M), f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) →
    ∀ {s : Finset ι}, s.Nonempty → ∀ (g : ι → M), f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $ M $ and $ N $ be monoids, with $ N $ an ordered commutative monoid. If $ f : M \to N $ is a submultiplicative function (i.e., $ f(xy) \leq f(x)f(y) $ for all $ x, y \in M $), then for any non-empty finite set $ s $ and function $ g : \iota \to M $, it holds that $ f\left(\prod_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \prod_{i \in s} f(g(i)) $.

  (∀ (a : α), 0 ≤ f a) →
